description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max users have reportedly started noticing discolouration on some units. On Reddit and X, many users have shared images of affected devices. The issue appears to be particularly noticeable on the Burgundy Red colour variant. Some Black models of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max have also reportedly been facing the issue. Apple has not yet commented on this discolouration issue.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Burgundy Red Models Reportedly Showing Discolouration, Users Share Photos

description: WhatsApp could require users to update their Android or iOS devices before allowing them to log into the app. The reported change is being tested on selected accounts and would prevent affected users from bypassing the software update. WhatsApp is also reportedly testing a warning for people using unofficial WhatsApp Web clients, asking them to switch to the official service. The company has not confirmed either development or specified which operating system versions could trigger the reported login restriction.
title: WhatsApp Could Block Users From Logging In on Outdated Android, iOS Devices

description: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses are reportedly receiving new features with the v128 and v129 software updates. Version 128 could allow users to follow walking directions through their glasses using location data from a connected smartphone. It is also said to introduce Spatial Audio. Meanwhile, version 129 reportedly brings Mono Audio and Audio Balance options, allowing users to change how sound is delivered through the speakers. The newer update is still rolling out, while v128 is reportedly more widely available.
title: Ray-Ban Meta Update Adds Walking Navigation, Spatial Audio and New Accessibility Controls

description: Gears of War: E-Day supports Nvidia's RTX Mega Geometry, a real-time rendering and ray tracing technology that boosts geometric detail and improves ray tracing quality across shadows, reflections, and global illumination. Mega Geometry, available on GeForce RTX GPUs, enables ray-traced Nanite geometry— Gears of War: E-Day is the first title to feature ray tracing geometry. We played Gears of War: E-Day on a GeForce RTX 5090 GPU to test the high-end PC features of the game.
title: Gears of War: E-Day PC Performance Review: The Best Looking Game in Years

description: Ethereum developers are preparing to test a 200 million gas limit on Sepolia as part of the Glamsterdam upgrade. Prysm 7.2.1 includes the new configuration, replacing the 60 million default that would have applied to validators using the previous client version. The test will help developers assess how validators handle larger blocks before decisions on mainnet capacity are made.
title: Ethereum Sets 200 Million Gas Limit for Glamsterdam Sepolia Test

description: Vivo has launched the Vivo X Fold 6, Vivo S2 FE and Vivo V80 smartphones in India on Tuesday. During the launch event, the Chinese tech brand disclosed the OriginOS 7 India rollout schedule. Here is a complete list of eligible Vivo phones confirmed to get OriginOS 7, based on Android 17, in the coming days. The first batch will include the Vivo X Fold 5, Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300 Pro, Vivo X300, and Vivo X300 FE.
title: Vivo OriginOS 7 India Rollout Timeline Revealed: Check Eligible Phones and Update Schedule

description: JBL has added six PartyBox speakers and the EasySing Mics to its India lineup, covering models designed for large gatherings, portable use and karaoke. The PartyBox 720 leads the range with 800W RMS output, while the PartyBox 330 offers the longest playback time at up to 18 hours. Other models include the PartyBox 130 and two On-The-Go variants. JBL has also added AI-based features such as vocal removal, voice enhancement and noise suppression to selected speakers and microphones.
title: JBL PartyBox 720, 330, 130 and On-The-Go 2 Series Launched in India Alongside EasySing Mics

description: Solana Foundation has launched Solana DvP, an open-source delivery-versus-payment programme designed for financial institutions handling tokenised assets and payments. The MIT-licensed system links both legs of a transaction so that either both settle or neither does. JPMorgan provided input on institutional securities settlement practices but did not develop, operate, certify, or approve the system.
title: Solana Foundation Launches Institutional Settlement Programme With JPMorgan Input

description: OnePlus Ace 7 series is reportedly in development. The lineup is tipped to come with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The lineup could feature a 6.78-inch flat LTPS OLED display with a 1.5K resolution and a 185Hz refresh rate. OnePlus Ace 7 series is tipped to feature a 200-megapixel primary rear camera and a 16-megapixel front-facing camera. The OnePlus Ace 7 Pro is also expected to get a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto camera.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Series Specifications Leaked, Could Launch in India as OnePlus 16R

description: Infinix Smart 20 HD comes with a 6.67-inch HD+ screen offering a 120Hz refresh rate and 700 nits of HBM brightness. The budget smartphone is equipped with a Unisoc T7250 chipset, 3GB RAM and 64GB storage, with support for virtual RAM expansion and microSD storage. It also features 8-megapixel cameras on the front and rear, dual speakers with 300 percent Ultra Volume Mode, and Ultra Link for offline communication. A 5,000mAh battery supports 15W charging.
title: Infinix Smart 20 HD Launched in India With 120Hz Display, 5,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Lumio has introduced the Arc 7 (2026) projector in India with upgrades to brightness, contrast, colour coverage and storage. The LED projector supports 1080p output and screen sizes of up to 120 inches, while its Arc Light Engine 2 is sealed against dust. It runs Google TV on Android 14 and offers 32GB of storage, along with Netflix and Gemini support. Other features include dual 8W speakers, Dolby Audio, TOF autofocus, obstacle avoidance and STR8 auto-keystone correction.
title: Lumio Arc 7 (2026) Launched in India With 120-Inch Projection, Google TV: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo Find X10 series is confirmed to launch in India soon. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be among the first smartphones globally to feature MediaTek's flagship Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, Oppo and MediaTek announced at MediaTek Tech Day today. The Dimensity 9600 Pro uses a 2+3+3 CPU configuration. It includes two C2-Ultra cores clocked at up to 4.55GHz.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max India Launch Teased; Confirmed to Feature MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC

description: Asus has announced special festive offers on its laptops, gaming devices, tablets, and desktop PCs ahead of the upcoming festive season. The discounts will be offered during the Amazon Great Indian Festival and Flipkart Big Billion Days sales. Shoppers can grab products across Vivobook, Vivobook S, Zenbook, TUF Gaming and ROG lineups, with select models getting more than 50 percent discounts. In addition to price cuts, the company will also offer no-cost EMI options and other benefits.
title: Asus Announces Up to 58 Percent Discount on Laptops During Amazon, Flipkart Festive Sales

description: Garmin Cirqa Smart Band has been launched in India. It is the latest addition to the company’s health-focused wearable lineup. As per the company, it is a screen-free fitness tracker that eliminates the distractions of a display while still delivering on health, sleep and activity tracking. It supports features including heart-rate monitoring, Body Battery, stress tracking, sleep analysis, skin temperature and activity detection. Garmin claims up to 10 days of battery life on the Cirqa Smart Band.
title: Garmin Cirqa Smart Band Launched in India With Screen-Less Design, Advanced Sleep Tracking: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo has brought its latest foldable smartphone to India following its China debut earlier this year. The Vivo X Fold 6 features two AMOLED displays, including an 8.02-inch inner screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super chipset and offers 12GB RAM and 512GB storage. The phone also gets a 200-megapixel main camera, dual 20-megapixel selfie cameras, 8K video recording and a 6,900mAh battery with support for 80W fast charging.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Launched in India With 8.02-Inch Foldable Display, 6,900mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Vivo S2 FE has been launched in India with a 10,000mAh battery. It has a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7300e 5G chipset and comes with up to 8GB RAM and 128GB of RAM. The new phone is offered in three colour options in India. It has a 32-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: Vivo S2 FE Launched in India With MediaTek Dimensity 7300e SoC, 10,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo V80 was launched in India on Tuesday as the latest addition to its V-series lineup. The handset arrives as the successor to the Vivo V70, which debuted in February. It sports a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset and runs Android 17-based OriginOS 7. It features a triple rear camera setup co-developed with Zeiss. The Vivo V80 packs a 7,200mAh battery.
title: Vivo V80 Launched in India With 144Hz Display, 50-Megapixel Zeiss Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: The JBL Live Beam 4 features 10mm Dynamic Drivers, Hi-Res Audio, JBL Spatial Sound Personi-Fi 3.0, Personal Sound Amplification, and Low Volume EQ. The TWS also ships with JBL Signature Sound tuning, True Adaptive Noise Cancellation 2.0, a six-microphone setup, and more. Check out the review to know more about the latest earbuds from JBL.
title: JBL Live Beam 4 Review: Great Sound Meets a Clever Touchscreen Case

description: Vivo showcased its Vision Discovery Edition mixed reality headset at its Vivo NEXT event in India on Tuesday. The headset is advertised as a spatial computing device. It sports dual Micro-OLED displays with eye tracking and gesture-based controls. The mixed reality headset is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 platform and runs Vivo's OriginOS Vision. While pricing and availability details remain under wraps, customers will be able to experience the Vivo Vision Discovery Edition at Vivo stores across the country.
title: Vivo Vision Discovery Edition Mixed Reality Headset Showcased at Vivo NEXT 2026 in India

description: OpenAI will show invisible watermarks for text generated by ChatGPT and Codex. The latest move by OpenAI will make it easier for readers to identify AI-generated content. This feature will be initially available in the European Union. Additionally, ChatGPT is all set to show more ads in the coming days. The new ads will appear alongside images that users ask ChatGPT to generate.
title: OpenAI to Add Invisible Watermarks to ChatGPT Text in EU; Set to Test New Ad Format

description: Virtuals Protocol has launched its Virtuals App in a closed iOS beta, allowing selected users to assign AI agents to wallets, monitor markets, and execute trades based on predefined instructions. The platform uses a chat interface for research and execution, while group chats can let users discuss investments alongside their personal AI agents.
title: Virtuals Protocol Adds AI-Powered Trading Through New iOS App

description: Hisense has announced festive offers on select television models during the upcoming Amazon Great Indian Festival and Flipkart Big Billion Days sales. The offers include discounts of up to 40 percent and cashback of up to Rs. 50,000, along with zero down payment and no-cost EMI options on eligible models. The festive lineup includes Hisense’s RGB MiniLED UR8S, MiniLED E8S, 4K QLED E75Q and 4K LED E6S series. Select Toshiba MiniLED and Mini Dimming TVs will also be available with offers during the sale season.
title: Hisense Announces Festive TV Offers Ahead of Amazon Great Indian Festival, Flipkart Big Billion Days Sales

description: Samsung has reportedly started mass production of its Exynos 2700 chipset ahead of the Galaxy S27 series launch. A report claims that production has increased by more than 10 percent compared with the Exynos 2600, partly due to the expected Galaxy S27 Pro. The Exynos 2700 is tipped for the Galaxy S27, S27 Plus and S27 Pro in South Korea and Europe, while Qualcomm chips could be used in the US and China. Samsung is also considering the Exynos 2700 for the Galaxy S27 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro Tipped to Get Exynos 2700 in Some Markets

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra is expected to be launched early next year. A new leak suggests that Samsung could offer the device in Black, Blue, Light Pink, Violet and White colours. For comparison, the Galaxy S26 Ultra is offered in Black, Cobalt Violet, Pink Gold (online-exclusive), Sky Blue, Silver Shadow (online-exclusive), and White colours. It could receive a significant design change. It could feature a raised camera island. It is likely to ship with a 200-megapixel primary rear camera.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Colour Options Leak, Light Pink and Violet Shades Tipped

description: Bitcoin is holding near $86,000 after briefly approaching $87,000, with weaker US jobs data reducing expectations of an October Federal Reserve rate hike. Large purchases by Strive and Strategy are supporting sentiment, while elevated Treasury yields and mixed ETF flows could keep the recovery measured.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $86,000 as Weak Jobs Data Dims Fed Hike Bets

description: Google has increased the price of the Pixel 10a in India and global markets. The handset was launched earlier this year as the latest affordable entry point into the Pixel 10 lineup. Its price has now been hiked by Rs. 6,000. The price revision is not limited to India; Google has also hiked the Pixel 10a's price in the US and other markets. The development comes amidst soaring prices of RAM and storage components as demand for AI data centres keeps rising.
title: Google Pixel 10a Gets Rs. 6,000 Price Hike in India, Gets Costlier Globally

description: Ninja Theory has begun laying off employees as the British studio faces closure following the latest round of cuts at Xbox. Several employees confirmed that layoffs at the studio had begun. Last month, Xbox announced that two separate agreements to divest Ninja Theory had fallen through. Microsoft said it was in consultation with Ninja Theory employees over a proposed closure, but would continue to explore other options for the Hellblade studio.
title: Hellblade Developer Ninja Theory Hit With Layoffs as Studio Faces Closure

description: Ghost of Yotei’s new story expansion, Echoes of Sekigahara, is held back by the limits of its foundations. Sucker Punch’s follow-up to Ghost of Tsushima was a robust sequel with modest ambitions. It refined the diegetic open-world exploration and slick swordplay of Tsushima, but it did little to distinguish itself from its predecessor. Ghost of Yotei’s worst offence was that it was safe. The game’s new expansion is guilty of the same.
title: Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition Review: Echoes of Excellence

description: Following a busy September where products across multiple categories were unveiled, Apple appears to be preparing for a similar October. According to a report, the Cupertino-based tech giant may announce several products this month, expanding its smart home portfolio. While the long-awaited smart home hub has been on the cards for some time, a recent development suggests that several Mac models could see the light of day, too, alongside the next-generation iPad mini.
title: Apple Reportedly Planning Two October Launches With Smart Home Hub, New Macs, and Home Products

description: Google launched the Pixel 11 series just a few months ago, and rumours about its potential successor have already begun surfacing. The lineup, widely known as the Pixel 12 family, is expected to arrive in 2027 and could include four models. A new report suggests that the Mountain View-based tech giant may bring display upgrades across the series. The foldable model will reportedly be on the receiving end of the biggest increase in terms of screen resolution.
title: Google Pixel 12 Series Leak Reveals Display Upgrades Across the Board; May Launch With Android 18
